title: Rogers Corporation Provides 2030 Financial Targets at 2026 Investor Day
summary: Enter News Body for Rogers Corporation Provides 2030 Financial Targets at 2026 Investor Day
body_markdown:
##### Release Date: 09/30/2026


### Company outlines path to $1.5 billion in revenue, a 26% Adjusted EBITDA margin and $14.00 of Adjusted EPS by 2030


Chandler, Arizona, September 30, 2026: Rogers Corporation (NYSE: ROG) (“Rogers”) today presented its strategy to accelerate growth, expand profitability and increase earnings through 2030 at the Company’s 2026 Investor Day.


The event featured presentations from Ali El-Haj, Rogers’ President and Chief Executive Officer; Laura Russell, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer; and other members of the leadership team.


“We are excited to share our plan to build a higher-growth, higher-performing Rogers,” said Ali El-Haj, President and Chief Executive Officer. “Our proven capabilities and deep customer relationships provide a strong foundation for growth. By applying these strengths across our core markets and targeted high-growth opportunities, we expect to deliver significant revenue growth, margin expansion and earnings improvement through 2030.”


### Rogers announced the following financial targets for 2028 and 2030:


2028 Targets 2030 Targets


Revenue $1.05 billion, +/- $50 million $1.5 billion


Adjusted EBITDA margin 20.5%, +/- 50 basis points 26%


Adjusted earnings per share $6.00, +/- $0.50 $14.00


### Event Details


An on-demand replay of the event and accompanying presentations are available at the Rogers investor relations website.[https://www.rogerscorp.com/investors](https://www.rogerscorp.com/investors) .


### About Rogers Corporation


Rogers Corporation (NYSE:ROG) is a global leader in engineered materials to power, protect and connect our world. Rogers delivers innovative solutions to help our customers solve their toughest material challenges. Rogers’ advanced electronic and elastomeric materials are used in applications for EV/HEV, automotive safety and radar systems, mobile devices, renewable energy, wireless infrastructure, energy-efficient motor drives, industrial equipment and more. Headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Rogers operates manufacturing facilities in the United States, Asia and Europe, with sales offices worldwide.

### Non-GAAP Items


The Company defines Adjusted EBITDA as net income excluding interest expense, net, income tax expense, depreciation and amortization, stock-based compensation expense and certain special items. Adjusted EBITDA Margin is defined as the percentage that results from dividing Adjusted EBITDA by net sales.


Adjusted earnings per diluted share is defined as earnings per diluted share excluding certain special items, divided by adjusted weighted average shares outstanding – diluted.


We are not able to reconcile forward-looking non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA Margin and Adjusted EPS to the closest corresponding GAAP measures without unreasonable efforts, because we are unable to forecast certain items required to develop meaningful comparable GAAP financial measures.
